MODEL.en: What the model is built from: weight files, architecture variant and the text/VAE encoders.
MODEL.zh: 模型来源：权重文件、架构变体与文本/VAE 编码器。

DATA.en: The data layer: dataset lists, batching and token budget, caching, captions and augmentation.
DATA.zh: 数据层：数据集清单、批次与词元预算、缓存、打标与增强。

ADAPTER.en: Which adapter algorithm is trained, where it attaches, how it is scaled and whether full FT runs.
ADAPTER.zh: 训练哪种适配器、挂到哪些层、如何缩放，以及是否全量微调。

OBJECTIVE.en: The training objective: timestep sampling, loss function and loss weighting.
OBJECTIVE.zh: 训练目标：时间步采样、损失函数与损失加权。

OPTIM.en: Optimizer choice, learning rate and schedule, clipping, weight decay and EMA.
OPTIM.zh: 优化器选择、学习率与调度、梯度裁剪、权重衰减与 EMA。

PRECISION.en: Compute precision, the modules kept in fp32, and the fp16 numerical fixes.
PRECISION.zh: 计算精度、保持 fp32 的模块，以及 fp16 数值修复。

MEMORY.en: Memory placement: the profiled offload and streaming plan for weights, activations and optimiser state.
MEMORY.zh: 内存放置：权重、激活与优化器状态的卸载和流式计划。

PARALLEL.en: Multi-GPU layout (ddp, fsdp, pipeline, threaded) plus communication backend and timeouts.
PARALLEL.zh: 多卡布局（ddp、fsdp、pipeline、threaded）与通信后端、超时。

KERNELS.en: Kernel selection, the autotuning policy, the retune window and the torch.compile scope.
KERNELS.zh: 内核选择、自动调优策略、重调窗口与 torch.compile 范围。

RUNTIME.en: The run driver, step count, gradient accumulation and where the outputs land.
RUNTIME.zh: 运行驱动、总步数、梯度累积与产出目录。

LOGGING.en: What gets reported: sinks, intervals, progress bar, non-finite patience and profiling windows.
LOGGING.zh: 日志输出：接收端、间隔、进度条、非有限容忍与性能采样窗口。

SAMPLING.en: In-training preview sampling and the held-out validation pass.
SAMPLING.zh: 训练中的预览采样，以及留出集验证。

CHECKPOINT / EXPORT.en: Checkpoint cadence and retention, resume, and the ComfyUI / HF export layout.
CHECKPOINT / EXPORT.zh: 检查点保存节奏与保留数、恢复，以及 ComfyUI / HF 导出布局。

WEIGHTS.en: Base model root: ComfyUI models folder, HF pipeline dir, or one DiT file. Point it at your downloaded checkpoint first.
WEIGHTS.zh: 基础模型的根目录：ComfyUI models 文件夹、HF 流水线目录或单个 DiT 文件。首次配置或换底模时改这里。

VARIANT.en: Picks the base or sft model variant, and with it the default ComfyUI DiT file. Change it when you switch to SFT weights.
VARIANT.zh: 选择 base 或 sft 底模变体，同时决定默认加载哪个 ComfyUI DiT 文件。换用 SFT 权重时改。

ARCH_OVERRIDES.en: Overrides fields of MossArchConfig. Set it only for experimental architectures or to debug an arch mismatch.
ARCH_OVERRIDES.zh: 覆盖 MossArchConfig 的架构字段。只在实验性结构或排查架构不匹配时设置。

TRANSFORMER.en: Names the DiT file; empty picks the first match under WEIGHTS. Set it to use the bf16 DiT instead of the int8 one.
TRANSFORMER.zh: 指定 DiT 文件；留空按 WEIGHTS 里的顺序挑。想用 bf16 而非 int8 的 DiT 时改。

TEXT_ENCODER.en: Text-encoder file or Qwen3.5 dir; empty uses the WEIGHTS default. Set it to swap the encoder file or its precision.
TEXT_ENCODER.zh: 文本编码器文件或 Qwen3.5 目录；留空用 WEIGHTS 里的默认文件。换文件或换精度时改。

TEXT_DEVICE.en: GPU that runs the text encoder; empty follows the training device. Move it to another GPU when VRAM is tight.
TEXT_DEVICE.zh: 文本编码器跑在哪块卡；留空跟随训练设备。显存吃紧时把它挪到另一块 GPU。

TEXT_ENCODE.en: Text-encoder placement: memory mode, dtype, precision, batch, layout. Tune it when VRAM is tight.
TEXT_ENCODE.zh: 文本编码器的放置方案：显存模式、精度、批次与布局。显存紧张或预计算缓存时调它。

VAE.en: VAE file or folder; empty uses the one under WEIGHTS. Set it when you swap the VAE or it lives outside the default spot.
VAE.zh: VAE 文件或目录；留空时用 WEIGHTS 里的 vae。换 VAE 或它不在默认位置时改。

ENCODE_DEVICES.en: Encoder GPUs such as (4, 5): the text encoder and VAE run there while DEVICES only trains. Set it to take encoder VRAM off the training cards.
ENCODE_DEVICES.zh: 编码卡（如 (4, 5)）：文本编码器与 VAE 跑在这些卡上，DEVICES 只负责训练。想把编码显存从训练卡分出去时设。

ENCODE_DEPTH.en: Encode feed: micro-batches each data stream keeps encoded ahead of its training ranks. Raise it to smooth encoder stalls, at the cost of host RAM.
ENCODE_DEPTH.zh: 编码馈送：每条数据流提前编码好的微批数。调大可抹平编码停顿，代价是主机内存。

ENCODE_CHUNK.en: Encode feed: micro-batches per encoder request, one text-encoder call and one VAE call. Raise it to batch the encoder work harder.
ENCODE_CHUNK.zh: 编码馈送：每次编码器请求的微批数，对应一次文本编码与一次 VAE 调用。调大可让编码更批量化。

VAE_ENCODE.en: VAE placement plan: memory mode and chunking. Tune it to save VRAM or to speed up latent encoding.
VAE_ENCODE.zh: VAE 的放置方案：显存模式与分块粒。想省显存或加快潜变量编码时调它。

VAE_DTYPE.en: VAE compute dtype; auto picks bf16 where supported. Pin it by hand on older GPUs or when you need full fidelity.
VAE_DTYPE.zh: VAE 计算精度；auto 在支持 bf16 的卡上用 bf16。老卡或要更高保真时手动指定。

TRAIN_TEXT_REFINER.en: Also trains the two text-refiner blocks. They stay frozen by default; enable it to sharpen prompt following.
TRAIN_TEXT_REFINER.zh: 让适配器（或全量微调）也训练两个文本细化块。默认冻结，想强化提示词理解时打开。

DATASETS.en: List of dataset entries, each with a source and its arguments. Change it to swap datasets or blend several with weights.
DATASETS.zh: 数据集条目列表，每项含 source 与数据源参数。换训练集或按权重混合多个数据集时改。

RESOLUTION_MODE.en: Target-size rule: aspect-preserving resize, buckets, shifted or centered square crop. Change it to alter framing.
RESOLUTION_MODE.zh: 目标尺寸的算法：保比例缩放、宽高比桶、偏移方图或中心裁剪。想换训练构图策略时改。
RESOLUTION_MODE.doc: docs/zh-CN/concepts/data.md#分辨率批次划分与超长样本

TARGET_AREA.en: Target pixel area per image, which sets image tokens and VRAM. Lower it for small GPUs or a coarser resolution.
TARGET_AREA.zh: 每张图的目标像素面积，决定图像词元数与显存占用。显存不够或想降分辨率时调小。

SIZE_STEP.en: Pixel multiple every side must align to (16 = VAE /8 times patchify 2). Leave it alone unless the architecture changes.
SIZE_STEP.zh: 所有边长的对齐单位（16 = VAE /8 再 patchify 2）。除非改架构，一般不需要动。
SIZE_STEP.doc: docs/zh-CN/concepts/data.md#分辨率批次划分与超长样本

ASPECT_RANGE.en: Allowed width/height range; out-of-range images get cropped to the bound. Tighten it when a dataset has extreme shapes.
ASPECT_RANGE.zh: 允许的宽高比范围，超出的图会被裁到边界。数据集里有极端长图时收紧。

UPSCALE.en: Whether images smaller than the target get upscaled; never keeps them native. Keep never to avoid inventing pixels.
UPSCALE.zh: 是否放大小于目标的图；never 保留原始尺寸。小图数据集不想被插值时保持 never。

BATCHING.en: How batches are built: greedy token packing, first-fit packing, or fixed sample count. Tune for VRAM use and step time.
BATCHING.zh: 批次划分方式：按词元贪心拼接、首次适应装桶，或固定样本数。调显存利用率与步时。

MAX_TOKENS.en: Joint token cap (image + text) per batch per rank; it drives VRAM and throughput. The main VRAM knob.
MAX_TOKENS.zh: 每批每卡的联合词元上限（图像+文本），直接决定显存与吞吐。最常用的显存旋钮。

OVERLONG.en: Samples over MAX_TOKENS: drop them, truncate text, or drop image tokens. Change it when long images are common.
OVERLONG.zh: 超出 MAX_TOKENS 的样本怎么处理：丢弃、截断文本或随机丢图像词元。长图多时改。

BATCH_SIZE.en: Samples per batch per rank when BATCHING=count. Switch to the count mode before tuning it.
BATCH_SIZE.zh: BATCHING=count 时每批每卡的样本数。先切到按数量分批，再调它。

MAX_SAMPLES.en: Cap on samples in one token batch; 0 means no cap. Set it when short samples would otherwise pack too densely.
MAX_SAMPLES.zh: 单个词元批次的样本数上限，0 表示不限。短样本把批次塞得过密时设它。

TOKEN_BUDGET.en: How text tokens are known while planning: char estimate, render, or cached lengths only. Use exact for hard limits.
TOKEN_BUDGET.zh: 规划时如何得到文本词元数：按字符估算、逐条渲染，或只用缓存长度。要硬上限时用 exact。

CAPTION.en: Caption template: tag order, kept fields, shuffling, dropping. Change it to match your caption style or quality tags.
CAPTION.zh: 描述文本模板：标签顺序、保留字段、是否打乱与丢弃。换标注风格或质量词策略时改。

TEXT_DROP.en: Chance a sample uses the empty-prompt embedding, the unconditional branch for CFG. Raise it if CFG output is weak.
TEXT_DROP.zh: 每条样本改用空提示词嵌入的概率，即 CFG 的无条件分支。CFG 效果差时提高。

LATENT_CACHE.en: Latent cache mode: off, precomputed offline, or written during training. Precompute to skip VAE work in the loop.
LATENT_CACHE.zh: 潜变量缓存模式：不用、离线预计算或训练时在线写入。离线可省去训练中的 VAE 开销。

TEXT_CACHE.en: Text-embedding cache mode: off, offline, or online. Offline takes text encoding out of the training loop entirely.
TEXT_CACHE.zh: 文本嵌入缓存模式：off、离线或在线。离线可让训练循环完全不做文本编码。

CACHE_DIR.en: Where latent and text vaults live; empty uses the dataset's cache folder. Set it to share one cache across datasets.
CACHE_DIR.zh: 潜变量与文本缓存的存放目录，留空用数据集下的 cache。多数据集共享缓存时指定。

CACHE_DTYPE.en: Storage precision of cached latents and text (bf16/fp16/fp32/fp8). Lower it to save disk, raise it for fidelity.
CACHE_DTYPE.zh: 缓存中潜变量与文本的存储精度。想省磁盘降档，要更高保真时升档。

CAPTION_VARIANTS.en: How many caption renderings per image are cached and sampled from. Raise it to make training robust to caption order.
CAPTION_VARIANTS.zh: 每张图缓存并轮流抽取多少套描述变体。想增强对标注顺序的鲁棒性时增加。

FLIP.en: Turns on horizontal-flip augmentation. Leave it off for faces, text, or any left-right sensitive subject.
FLIP.zh: 开启水平翻转数据增强。人像、文字或方向敏感的题材不要打开。

CROP.en: Crop placement: fixed center or random. Random generalizes better, but offline latent caches require center.
CROP.zh: 裁剪位置：固定中心或随机。随机更耐构图，但离线潜变量缓存必须用 center。

PLANNER_KWARGS.en: Overrides planner arguments such as window and drop_last. Use it when the derived defaults do not fit your data.
PLANNER_KWARGS.zh: 覆盖规划器参数（window、drop_last 等）。默认推导值不适合你的数据时改。

LATENT_ENCODER_ID.en: VAE identity in the latent cache key. Change it together with the VAE, or old latents get reused wrongly.
LATENT_ENCODER_ID.zh: 潜变量缓存键里的 VAE 标识。换 VAE 必须同步改，否则会错用旧缓存。

LATENT_DRAW.en: How the VAE draws latents: the mode or a sample; part of the cache key. Keep mode for deterministic latents.
LATENT_DRAW.zh: VAE 取潜变量的方式：用众数还是采样，它也是缓存键的一部分。要确定性时用 mode。

TEXT_ENCODER_ID.en: Text-encoder identity in the text cache key. Update it whenever the text encoder or its precision changes.
TEXT_ENCODER_ID.zh: 文本缓存键里的编码器标识。换文本编码器或改精度时必须同步改。

BACKGROUND.en: Fill colour for images with transparency. Change it when the dataset includes alpha PNGs on a dark background.
BACKGROUND.zh: 透明图的填充底色。数据集含带 alpha 的 PNG 时按画面需要改。

RESAMPLE.en: Resize filter used when scaling images (lanczos and friends). Swap it for sharper or softer resampling.
RESAMPLE.zh: 缩放图像时用的重采样滤镜（lanczos 等）。想要更锐或更柔的边缘时换。

TEXT_CHARS_PER_TOKEN.en: Characters per token used when no cached length exists. Lower it for Chinese or Japanese captions.
TEXT_CHARS_PER_TOKEN.zh: 没有缓存长度时，按每词元多少字符估算文本。中/日文标注占比高时下调。

TEXT_OVERHEAD_TOKENS.en: Chat-template tokens added to every caption estimate. Adjust it when the prompt template or tokenizer changes.
TEXT_OVERHEAD_TOKENS.zh: 每条描述估算时额外加上的模板词元数。换提示词模板或分词器时微调。

MAX_TEXT_TOKENS.en: Cap on one caption's text tokens while planning. Raise it when long captions keep getting cut short.
MAX_TEXT_TOKENS.zh: 规划时单条描述允许的最大词元数。长标注被截得太狠时提高。

PREFETCH.en: Batches each loader worker prefetches. Raise it if the GPU starves for data, lower it to save host memory.
PREFETCH.zh: 每个加载器 worker 预取的批数。GPU 等数据时提高，主机内存紧时降低。

PIN_MEMORY.en: Pins host batches so device copies run asynchronously. Turn it off when host memory is scarce.
PIN_MEMORY.zh: 把主机批次放进锁页内存以异步拷贝到显卡。主机内存紧张时可以关掉。

NUM_WORKERS.en: Loader worker processes; each imports torch and costs host memory. Tune it for decode speed versus RAM.
NUM_WORKERS.zh: 数据加载 worker 进程数，每个都会导入 torch 占内存。在解码速度与主机内存间权衡。

DATA_RESCAN.en: How the catalog cache rescans: incremental, full re-probe, or none. Touch it after adding or removing images.
DATA_RESCAN.zh: 目录缓存如何重新扫描：增量、全量重探或不遍历。增删图片文件后才需要动它。

DATA_SCAN_WORKERS.en: Processes probing image headers during a (re)scan. Raise it when the first scan of a big folder is slow.
DATA_SCAN_WORKERS.zh: （重新）扫描时探测图像头的进程数。大目录首次扫描太慢时提高。

DATA_WAIT.en: Seconds a non-writer rank waits for the catalog writer. Increase it only when catalog builds are slow on many ranks.
DATA_WAIT.zh: 非写入 rank 等待目录写入者完成的最长秒数。多卡下目录构建慢时才加。

SEED.en: Global seed for init, noise and batch order. Pin it to reproduce a run or to compare hyperparameters fairly.
SEED.zh: 全局随机种子，决定初始化、噪声与批次顺序。复现实验或做对比时固定。

ALGO.en: Adapter algorithm: lora, locon, loha, lokr, oft; full means full fine-tuning. Change it to switch the training style.
ALGO.zh: 适配器算法：LoRA/LoCon/LoHa/LoKr/OFT 等，full 表示全量微调。换训练方式或换算法时改。

PRESET.en: Which linear layers get the adapter: attn, attn-mlp, full-block or all, plus modifiers. Widen or narrow the reach here.
PRESET.zh: 适配器加在哪些线性层：attn、attn-mlp、full-block、all，可加修饰符。要放窄或放大范围时改。

DIM.en: Adapter rank; on LoKr and OFT it is the block-size cap instead. Raise it for capacity, lower it to fight overfitting.
DIM.zh: 适配器秩；LoKr 与 OFT 下含义是块大小上限。容量不够时提高，过拟合时降低。

ALPHA.en: Adapter scaling alpha; together with DIM it sets the effective update strength. Retune it whenever you change the rank.
ALPHA.zh: 适配器缩放 alpha，与 DIM 一起决定有效更新强度。改秩后通常要同步调整。

ALGO_KWARGS.en: Extra LyCORIS module arguments such as LoKr's factor, passed through as-is. Use it for algorithm-level tuning.
ALGO_KWARGS.zh: 透传给 LyCORIS 模块构造函数的额外参数，如 LoKr 的 factor。需要算法级微调时用。

DORA.en: Enables DoRA weight decomposition (LyCORIS weight_decompose). Turn it on to get more quality out of a small rank.
DORA.zh: 启用 DoRA 权重分解（LyCORIS 的 weight_decompose）。小秩想提升质量时打开。

DORA_DETACH.en: Detaches the DoRA weight norm in training, using LyCORIS's unfused path. Use it to debug DoRA numerics.
DORA_DETACH.zh: 训练时分离 DoRA 的权重范数，走 LyCORIS 未融合路径。排查 DoRA 数值时用。

DROPOUT.en: The three dropouts: input, rank and module level. Raise them against overfitting, lower them when underfitting.
DROPOUT.zh: 三种 dropout：输入级、秩级与模块级。过拟合时提高，欠拟合时降低。

ADAPTER_MODE.en: Bypass add-on or one GEMM over W+dW. Merge saves inference math; quantized or streamed bases must stay bypass.
ADAPTER_MODE.zh: 旁路叠加还是对 W+dW 做一次 GEMM。merge 省推理算力，量化或流式底座必须 bypass。

LORAPLUS_RATIO.en: LoRA+ learning-rate ratio between the up and down factors. Set it above 1 so the factors converge at different speeds.
LORAPLUS_RATIO.zh: LoRA+ 里 up/down 因子的学习率比例。想让两个因子异步收敛时调到 1 以上。

TRAIN_NORMS.en: Also trains deltas on the normalization layers the preset covers. Enable it when style transfer needs a stronger push.
TRAIN_NORMS.zh: 同时训练预设覆盖的归一化层上的增量。风格迁移需要更强干预时打开。

TIMESTEP.en: Timestep sampler: moss (the technical-report scheme), uniform or logit_normal. Use it to reshape the sigma spread.
TIMESTEP.zh: 时间步采样器：moss（技术报告方案）、uniform 或 logit_normal。想换训练分布时改。

TIMESTEP_KWARGS.en: Sampler parameters: mu, s, shift, cutoff and the uniform share. Tune them to nudge the sampled sigma distribution.
TIMESTEP_KWARGS.zh: 时间步采样器的参数：mu、s、shift、cutoff 与 uniform 占比。微调 sigma 分布时用。

LOSS.en: Loss function: mse, huber, l1, or masked_mse when a per-token mask exists. Switch it to be robust to outliers.
LOSS.zh: 损失函数：mse、huber、l1，或需要逐词元掩码的 masked_mse。要抗离群值时换。

LOSS_KWARGS.en: Extra arguments for the chosen loss, such as huber's delta. Use it when the loss default is too coarse.
LOSS_KWARGS.zh: 所选损失的额外参数，如 huber 的 delta。损失默认参数太粗时用来细调。

WEIGHTING.en: Multiplies a sigma-dependent weight onto the loss: none is the MOSS scheme, x0 and eps match other spaces.
WEIGHTING.zh: 把依赖 sigma 的权重乘到损失上：none 是 MOSS 方案，x0/eps 对应其他目标空间。

OPTIMIZER.en: Optimizer: adamw, adamw16, 8-bit variants, muon, prodigy and friends. Change it for memory or convergence behaviour.
OPTIMIZER.zh: 优化器算法与实现：adamw、adamw16、8bit 变体、muon、prodigy 等。换显存策略或收敛方式时改。

OPTIMIZER_KWARGS.en: Optimizer-specific arguments such as adamw16 rounding or muon momentum, validated per builder.
OPTIMIZER_KWARGS.zh: 优化器自身参数，如 adamw16 的 rounding、muon 的 momentum，按算法校验后透传。

LR.en: Base learning rate, the starting point for every parameter group. The first thing to retune after rank or data changes.
LR.zh: 基础学习率，所有参数组的起点。换秩、换数据集或换算法后最该重调的项。

BETAS.en: Adam/AdamW first and second moment coefficients. Nudge them when gradients live at a different noise scale.
BETAS.zh: Adam/AdamW 的一阶与二阶动量系数。梯度噪声尺度变化时微调。

EPS.en: Optimizer epsilon that guards the division. Only touch it when low-precision training starts producing NaNs.
EPS.zh: 优化器的 epsilon，防止除零。低精度训练开始出 NaN 时才考虑调。

WEIGHT_DECAY.en: Weight-decay strength; WD_RULES decides which tensors it touches. Tune it to control drift and overfitting.
WEIGHT_DECAY.zh: 权重衰减强度，作用范围由 WD_RULES 决定。想控制漂移或过拟合时调。

WD_RULES.en: Which tensors weight decay touches: moss only 2-D weights, none, or all. Change it for unusual regularization needs.
WD_RULES.zh: 权重衰减的作用范围：moss 只碰二维权重，none 关闭，all 全部。需要非常规正则时改。

SCHEDULE.en: Learning-rate schedule: mode, warmup steps and end step; end -1 means STEPS. Change it for another curve or warmup.
SCHEDULE.zh: 学习率调度：模式、预热步数、结束步，end 为 -1 表示用 STEPS。换曲线或改预热时调。

GRAD_CLIP.en: Global gradient-norm clip; each step is scaled by the previous norm. Lower it only when gradients blow up.
GRAD_CLIP.zh: 全局梯度范数裁剪阈值，用上一步范数缩放当步梯度。梯度爆炸时才需要调小。

EMA.en: Exponential moving average of the weights; 0 turns it off. Enable it for steadier sampling weights in full fine-tunes.
EMA.zh: 参数的指数移动平均系数，0 表示关闭。全量微调想要更稳的采样权重时打开。

PRECISION.en: Compute precision for forward and backward: bf16, fp16 or auto. Switch to fp16 on GPUs without bf16 support.
PRECISION.zh: 前向与反向的计算精度：bf16、fp16 或 auto。显卡不支持 bf16 时切 fp16。

KEEP_FP32.en: Modules kept in fp32: time embedding, shared modulation, output-head modulation. Add entries when they go unstable.
KEEP_FP32.zh: 保持 fp32 的模块：时间嵌入、共享调制、输出头调制。这些模块数值不稳时可再加。

FP16_FIX.en: The fp16 numerical fix: none, online runtime factors, or fp32_residual. Pick one when fp16 training overflows.
FP16_FIX.zh: fp16 数值修复：none、online 运行时因子或 fp32_residual。fp16 训练溢出时选一种。

FP16_FIX_KWARGS.en: Arguments for the fp16 fix, such as the online scaling factor c. Tune the scaling when the default fix is not enough.
FP16_FIX_KWARGS.zh: fp16 修复的参数，如 online 模式的缩放系数 c。默认修复不够时微调缩放。

MEMORY_PROFILE.en: Memory-placement catalog profile: speed, balanced, low, minimal, auto, manual. Pick one before tuning offload knobs.
MEMORY_PROFILE.zh: 内存放置配置档：speed/balanced/low/minimal/auto 等。先选档再手调。

MEMORY_AUTO_FORCE.en: In auto mode with no profile that fits: False errors out, True runs the last one anyway with a warning.
MEMORY_AUTO_FORCE.zh: auto 模式下无档装得下时：False 报错，True 硬跑最后一档并记 WARNING。

STEP_RELEASE.en: Releases free cached device memory between steps: none, empty_cache every step (synchronises), or every N steps.
STEP_RELEASE.zh: 步间释放空闲的缓存显存：none、每步 empty_cache（会同步）或每 N 步一次。

CHECKPOINT.en: Gradient checkpointing: which activations backward recomputes. none, block, sub-block, selective, partial:<fraction>.
CHECKPOINT.zh: 梯度检查点：决定反向重算哪些激活，none、block、sub-block、selective 等。

STREAM.en: Block weights live on host and stream in: off (resident), ring (frozen base), swap (trainable full-FT masters).
STREAM.zh: 块权重放主机再流式传入：off 常驻、ring 冻结基座、swap 可训练主副本。

STREAM_RESIDENT.en: Device block slots kept resident while streaming, at least 2. Raise it to trade VRAM for fewer host transfers.
STREAM_RESIDENT.zh: 流式传输时保留在设备上的块槽数，至少 2。调大用显存换更少的主机搬运。

PINNED.en: Uses pinned host memory for every offload; False falls back to pageable buffers with staged copies.
PINNED.zh: 所有卸载都用锁页主机内存；False 退回可分页缓冲区加中转拷贝。

ACT_OFFLOAD.en: Saved activations move to pinned host memory and are prefetched a block ahead. Enable it when activations dominate VRAM.
ACT_OFFLOAD.zh: 保存的激活移入锁页主机内存并提前一块预取。激活占显存大头时打开。

OPTIM_STATE.en: AdamW state placement only: gpu, stream (host state, GPU update) or cpu (host update). Other optimizers stay on gpu.
OPTIM_STATE.zh: 只控制 AdamW 状态放置：gpu、stream（主机状态、GPU 上更新）、cpu（主机更新）。

GRAD_OFFLOAD.en: Gradients leave the device after accumulation and are summed over GRAD_ACC micro-batches in fp32 host memory.
GRAD_OFFLOAD.zh: 梯度累积后立即离开设备，在 fp32 主机内存里对 GRAD_ACC 个微批次求和。

FUSED_STEP.en: Runs the per-parameter optimizer update inside backward. Rejected with muon; saves the separate step buffers.
FUSED_STEP.zh: 在反向内部完成逐参数优化器更新。与 muon 互斥，省掉独立的一步缓冲。

BASE_PRECISION.en: How the frozen base is stored: auto, compute, int8, fp8, fp8_compute, mxfp8, quant. Full FT needs compute.
BASE_PRECISION.zh: 冻结基座存储方式：auto、compute、fp8_compute 等；全量微调要用 compute。

FP8_RECIPE.en: Scaling granularity for fp8_compute: tensor, row or block. Finer costs extra scale factors but holds accuracy.
FP8_RECIPE.zh: fp8_compute 的缩放粒度：tensor、row、block。越细越准，但要多存缩放因子。

FP8_DGRAD.en: Input-gradient GEMM in fp8 (keeps an fp8 W^T copy, 2 B per weight) or 16-bit (1 B per weight).
FP8_DGRAD.zh: 输入梯度 GEMM 用 fp8（保留 fp8 的 W^T 副本，每权重 2 字节）或 16 位（1 字节）。

INT8_COMPUTE.en: int8 bases run real int8 GEMMs (activations quantized per row) instead of weight-only. CUDA only, and it needs an int8 base.
INT8_COMPUTE.zh: int8 基座改跑真正的 int8 GEMM（激活按行量化），而非仅权重量化。仅 CUDA，且需 int8 基座。

INT8_DGRAD.en: Input-gradient GEMM of int8 compute: int8 (default) or 16bit. Switch to 16bit when int8 input gradients hurt accuracy.
INT8_DGRAD.zh: int8 计算的输入梯度 GEMM：int8（默认）或 16bit。int8 输入梯度影响精度时换 16bit。

MEMORY_OVERRIDES.en: Raw MemoryPlan field overrides layered onto whichever profile mode is active. The escape hatch past the catalog.
MEMORY_OVERRIDES.zh: 原始 MemoryPlan 字段覆盖，叠加在当前模式之上。绕开配置档做细调的出口。

PARALLEL.en: Multi-GPU layout: none, ddp, fsdp, pipeline or threaded. The launcher starts one process per DEVICES entry.
PARALLEL.zh: 多卡布局：none、ddp、fsdp、pipeline、threaded。启动器为 DEVICES 每项起一个进程。

DIST_BACKEND.en: Process-group backend: auto (nccl on CUDA, xccl on XPU, else gloo), nccl or gloo. xccl is auto-only.
DIST_BACKEND.zh: 进程组后端：auto（CUDA 用 nccl、XPU 用 xccl、其余 gloo）、nccl 或 gloo。

DEVICES.en: Device list driving one launcher process per entry; also gates the bf16 support check for the chosen precision.
DEVICES.zh: 设备列表，每项起一个进程；同时用于校验所选精度是否支持 bf16。

PIPELINE_SCHEDULE.en: Pipeline schedule: gpipe, 1f1b, zbv, dualpipe-v and friends; threaded takes gpipe or async only.
PIPELINE_SCHEDULE.zh: 流水线调度：gpipe、1f1b、zbv 等；threaded 只支持 gpipe 与 async。

PIPELINE_SPLIT.en: How stages split the layers: measured, flops, even, or an explicit per-stage layer count such as (11, 10, 11, 10).
PIPELINE_SPLIT.zh: 阶段切分层的方式：measured、flops、even，或每阶段层数如 (11,10,11,10)。

MICROBATCHES.en: Micro-batches per step in pipeline and threaded layouts; most schedules require at least the rank count.
MICROBATCHES.zh: 流水线与线程化布局下每一步的微批次数；多数调度要求不小于卡数。

FSDP_REDUCE.en: With FSDP and GRAD_ACC above 1: step does one reduce-scatter per step, micro does it every micro-batch.
FSDP_REDUCE.zh: FSDP 且 GRAD_ACC 大于 1 时：step 每步归约一次，micro 每微批次一次。

FSDP_RESHARD.en: Block parameters: forward frees them after each block (ZeRO-3); backward holds them unsharded (ZeRO-2).
FSDP_RESHARD.zh: 块参数：forward 每块前向后释放（ZeRO-3），backward 保持未分片（ZeRO-2）。

DDP_BACKEND.en: ddp reducers: kohakumoss (project reducers, every memory plan) or torch (stock DDP, the A/B baseline).
DDP_BACKEND.zh: ddp 归约器：kohakumoss（项目自带，全档可用）或 torch（原生 DDP，当基线）。

DDP_REDUCE_DTYPE.en: Reduction dtype for the gradient all-reduce; fp32 sums exactly, other values trade accuracy for bandwidth.
DDP_REDUCE_DTYPE.zh: 梯度 all-reduce 的归约精度；fp32 精确求和，其他值拿精度换带宽。

DIST_TIMEOUT.en: Per-operation and store wait time in seconds. Raise it on slow interconnects or large allocations.
DIST_TIMEOUT.zh: 每次集合通信与存储等待的秒数。互联慢或集群大时调大。

DIST_GATE_TIMEOUT.en: Seconds a store gate waits for rank-0-only or per-rank startup work such as catalog scans, tuning or saves.
DIST_GATE_TIMEOUT.zh: 存储门控等待 rank0 专属或各 rank 启动工作的秒数，如扫描、调优、存档。

DIST_BIND.en: Process-group device binding: lazy builds communicators on first use, device binds them at init.
DIST_BIND.zh: 进程组设备绑定：lazy 首次使用时建通信器，device 初始化即绑定。

KERNELS.en: Per-family kernel choices such as KERNELS["lycoris"] = auto or a backend name; overrides the plan's bindings.
KERNELS.zh: 按家族的算子选择，如 KERNELS["lycoris"] 填 auto 或后端名，覆盖计划绑定。

TUNE.en: table binds stored decisions and tunes the missing ones in the prewarm before step 0; off never times anything.
TUNE.zh: table 绑定已存决策，缺的在第 0 步前预热中调；off 完全不计时。

RETUNE_STEPS.en: With TUNE=table, re-compares kernels against compile after each of the first N steps, then stops queueing shapes.
RETUNE_STEPS.zh: TUNE=table 时前 N 步每步后重比内核与 compile，之后不再排队新形状。

COMPILE.en: torch.compile scope: off, block (per block) or model (whole model). Big speedups cost extra compile time.
COMPILE.zh: torch.compile 的范围：off、block（按块）、model（整模型）。提速换来编译耗时。

DRIVER.en: Training loop driver: native or lightning (manual optimisation); both run the same TrainStep to equal parameters.
DRIVER.zh: 训练循环驱动：native 或 lightning（手动优化）。两者跑同样的 TrainStep，参数一致。

STEPS.en: Total optimiser steps in the run; drives the progress bar and the SCHEDULE end: -1 default.
STEPS.zh: 本次运行的总优化步数；决定进度条与 SCHEDULE 中 end=-1 的取值。

GRAD_ACC.en: Gradient accumulation: micro-batches summed into one optimiser step, losses normalised by the global token count.
GRAD_ACC.zh: 梯度累积：多个微批次合成一步，损失按全局词元数归一化。

OUTPUT_DIR.en: Root directory for runs, checkpoints, metrics and traces. Point it at a fast disk with room for saves.
OUTPUT_DIR.zh: 运行根目录：检查点、指标、跟踪文件都写这里。指到够大够快的盘上。

RUN_NAME.en: Name distinguishing this run's outputs under OUTPUT_DIR; set one per sweep member to avoid overwrites.
RUN_NAME.zh: 本次运行在 OUTPUT_DIR 下的名字后缀。扫描多组配置时各设一个以免覆盖。

LOGGER.en: Console-side sink besides metrics.jsonl: console or wandb. Enable wandb to track runs across machines.
LOGGER.zh: 除 metrics.jsonl 外的接收端：console 或 wandb。要跨机追踪时开 wandb。

PROJECT.en: Name reported to the external sink, grouping this run's metrics under one project. Set it per experiment series.
PROJECT.zh: 上报给外部接收端的项目名，把本次指标归到同一项目下。

LOG_EVERY.en: Console step-line interval when the bar is off, and the default for METRICS_EVERY. First and last steps always print.
LOG_EVERY.zh: 关掉进度条时控制台日志行的间隔，也是 METRICS_EVERY 的默认值。

METRICS_EVERY.en: How often metric rows reach metrics.jsonl and wandb, and the throughput, VRAM and encoder monitors; 1 per step.
METRICS_EVERY.zh: 指标行写入 metrics.jsonl 与 wandb 的间隔，也驱动吞吐、显存监视器。

PROGRESS.en: tqdm progress bar over STEPS, shown on a TTY or when FORCE_COLOR=1. Turn it off for clean logs.
PROGRESS.zh: 覆盖 STEPS 的 tqdm 进度条，TTY 或 FORCE_COLOR=1 时显示。要干净日志就关。

NONFINITE_PATIENCE.en: Stops after N non-finite steps at the loss-scale floor, or N steps with the same bad parameters; 0 disables.
NONFINITE_PATIENCE.zh: 损失缩放触底或同一批参数连续 N 步非有限时停下并转储复现；0 关闭。

TRACE_STEPS.en: (first, last): runs torch.profiler over steps first+1..last on every rank and writes Chrome traces under ranks/.
TRACE_STEPS.zh: (first, last)：每个 rank 用 torch.profiler 采样这些步，写 Chrome trace。

PROFILE_STEPS.en: (first, last): wraps cudaProfilerStart/Stop around those steps so ncu or nsys captures exactly that window.
PROFILE_STEPS.zh: (first, last)：在该窗口内启停 cudaProfiler，供 ncu 或 nsys 精确抓取。

SAMPLE_PROMPTS.en: Prompts rendered at each sampling step to preview the adapter. Set the look you want to track during training.
SAMPLE_PROMPTS.zh: 每个采样步渲染的提示词，用来预览适配器效果。设成想持续观察的画面。
SAMPLE_PROMPTS.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

SAMPLE_NEGATIVE.en: Negative prompt shared by every sample and paired with the guidance scale. Set it to lock a baseline look.
SAMPLE_NEGATIVE.zh: 所有采样共用的负向提示词，与 CFG 一起生效。想锁定基线画风时设置。
SAMPLE_NEGATIVE.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

SAMPLE_EVERY.en: Steps between sampling passes; 0 disables in-training sampling. fsdp layouts reject it because sampling is rank 0 only.
SAMPLE_EVERY.zh: 采样间隔步数，0 关闭训练中采样。fsdp 布局会拒绝，因为采样只在 rank0。

SAMPLE_STEPS.en: Denoising steps per sample; more steps cost training time but reveal the adapter's ceiling better.
SAMPLE_STEPS.zh: 每张采样的去噪步数。步数越多越能看出上限，但更吃训练时间。
SAMPLE_STEPS.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

SAMPLE_CFG.en: Classifier-free guidance scale for samples. Keep it at the deployment value so previews match inference.
SAMPLE_CFG.zh: 采样的无分类器引导强度。保持与推理一致，预览才对得上交付效果。
SAMPLE_CFG.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

SAMPLE_SHIFT.en: Sigma shift for the sampling schedule; keep it equal to the shift you plan to use at inference.
SAMPLE_SHIFT.zh: 采样调度里的 sigma 偏移量。与推理时要用的 shift 保持一致。
SAMPLE_SHIFT.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

SAMPLE_SKIP_LAYERS.en: Block indices the sampling pass skips, trading detail for preview speed and VRAM.
SAMPLE_SKIP_LAYERS.zh: 采样时跳过的块索引，用细节换预览的速度与显存。
SAMPLE_SKIP_LAYERS.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

SAMPLE_SIZE.en: Sample resolution; set it to the training area so previews reflect the trained geometry.
SAMPLE_SIZE.zh: 采样分辨率。设成训练时的面积，预览才能反映真实构图。
SAMPLE_SIZE.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

SAMPLE_SEEDS.en: Seeds for the sampling passes; keep them fixed so successive previews stay comparable.
SAMPLE_SEEDS.zh: 采样用的种子。固定下来，前后几次预览才可比较。
SAMPLE_SEEDS.doc: docs/zh-CN/guides/inference.md#与训练脚本共享的设置

VALIDATE_EVERY.en: Steps between validation passes over the VALIDATION datasets; 0 disables it. Each pass runs a forward on every rank.
VALIDATE_EVERY.zh: 在验证集上跑验证的间隔步数，0 关闭。每次验证在所有 rank 上前向一遍。

VALIDATION.en: Validation set and loss settings: datasets, sigma grid and seed. Fill it when you want held-out loss curves.
VALIDATION.zh: 验证集与损失设置：datasets、sigmas、seed。想要留出集曲线时填。

SAVE_EVERY.en: Steps between resume checkpoints; 0 disables periodic saving. Written into .partial first, then renamed.
SAVE_EVERY.zh: 保存可恢复检查点的间隔步数，0 关闭周期保存。先写 .partial 再原子改名。

SAVE_MINUTES.en: Wall-clock minutes between checkpoints, checked every LOG_EVERY steps. Use it when step duration varies.
SAVE_MINUTES.zh: 按墙钟时间保存的间隔分钟数，每 LOG_EVERY 步检查一次。步长不固定时用它。

KEEP_LAST.en: Checkpoints and their exports kept on disk; older ones are pruned. Raise it for long sweeps.
KEEP_LAST.zh: 磁盘上保留的检查点与其导出个数，更旧的会被清理。长扫描时调大。

FINAL_CHECKPOINT.en: Whether a resume checkpoint is written at the end: auto (only if periodic saving is on), True or False.
FINAL_CHECKPOINT.zh: 结束时是否再写可恢复检查点：auto（仅开启周期保存时）、True 或 False。

RESUME.en: Checkpoint directory to continue from, or latest for the newest. A resumed run appends to the existing logs.
RESUME.zh: 要继续训练的检查点目录，或填 latest 取最新一个。恢复后日志续写同一份。

SAVE_FORMAT.en: Export layout: comfy, hf, both or none. comfy writes ComfyUI files, hf uses diffusers key names.
SAVE_FORMAT.zh: 导出格式：comfy、hf、both、none。comfy 出 ComfyUI 文件，hf 用 diffusers 键。

SAVE_MERGED.en: Adapter runs only: also writes the merged DiT in SAVE_FORMAT so it loads without the adapter.
SAVE_MERGED.zh: 仅适配器运行有效：额外写出合并后的 DiT，不挂适配器也能直接加载。

SAVE_FUSED_QKV.en: Comfy files: stores joint q/k/v as one proj.qkv. auto follows how the trained DiT file stores them.
SAVE_FUSED_QKV.zh: Comfy 文件把联合 q/k/v 存成一个 proj.qkv；auto 跟随底座文件存法。

CHECKPOINT_EXPORT.en: Also writes the export files under every checkpoint's export/ folder; their size is logged at build.
CHECKPOINT_EXPORT.zh: 在每个检查点的 export/ 里也写一份导出，体积会在构建日志列出。

EXPORT_FORMATS.en: Older spelling of the export controls, mapped onto SAVE_FORMAT and SAVE_MERGED with one INFO line at validation.
EXPORT_FORMATS.zh: 导出控制项的旧写法，校验时映射到 SAVE_FORMAT 与 SAVE_MERGED。
